hypotheses.question: Does combining a KRAS G12C inhibitor with an SHP2 inhibitor show evidence of benefit over the KRAS G12C inhibitor alone in NSCLC?
hypotheses.rationale: Adaptive RTK-SHP2-RAS feedback is a widely studied resistance route to KRAS G12C inhibition; curator-selected because the literature contains both supporting preclinical work and cautionary clinical findings.

hypotheses.question: Does combining a KRAS G12C inhibitor with an EGFR inhibitor show evidence of benefit in KRAS G12C NSCLC?
hypotheses.rationale: Curator-selected: strong evidence exists in colorectal cancer, which makes it a deliberate test of whether the agent keeps other-tumor evidence out of direct support for NSCLC.
